name: Warrant
definition: Financial instrument that gives the holder the right to purchase shares or bonds at a given price within a specified time.

Multiplier.name: Multiplier
Multiplier.definition: Specifies the ratio or multiply factor used to convert from contracts to shares.

Style.name: Style
Style.definition: Specifies the expiration style of the warrant.

SubscriptionPrice.name: Subscription Price
SubscriptionPrice.definition: Pre-determined price at which the holder of a warrant is entitled to buy the underlying instrument.

WarrantParity.name: Warrant Parity
WarrantParity.definition: Provides the ratio between the quantity of warrants and the quantity of underlying securities.
